display.purpose: Fraunces editorial headlines; italic light accent lines.

mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono uppercase labels and tags.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Iris pill, white text; deepens on hover with soft coloured shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #4338ca; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px rgba(79,70,229,0.55); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Frosted glass card: white 65%, blur 16px, hairline border, soft layered shadow.
components.html:
Step 1

Title

Body text on frosted glass.
components.css: .ds-glass { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(22,24,29,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,30,0.04), 0 16px 40px -16px rgba(20,20,30,0.14); padding: 24px; color: #16181d; } .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4f46e5; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-glass h3 { font-family: var(--font-display), Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-glass p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4d525c; margin: 0; }

components.name: Ribbon
components.description: Independent-demo notice: white/60 blur band, amber dot, mono tag.
components.html: IndependentPraja-RTI is a hackathon demo — nothing is filed with any government system.
components.css: .ds-ribbon { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 24px; font-size: 13px; color: #4d525c; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(22,24,29,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #92400e; } .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #92400e; }

components.name: Step Tab
components.description: Glass step chip; active = iris tint + iris text.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 14px 10px; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; border: 1px solid rgba(22,24,29,0.08); border-bottom: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: #4d525c; font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab-active { background: rgba(79,70,229,0.08); border-color: rgba(79,70,229,0.3); color: #4f46e5; }

narrative.northStar: A quiet editorial desk by a window
narrative.overview: Ivory paper ground, pastel light moving through frosted glass, one calm indigo signal. The surface refuses the dark-instrument console, the neon demo aesthetic, and every government-portal habit. Fraunces carries the editorial voice — including a light italic second line in the headline. React Bits motion: a pastel Aurora wash behind the hero, BlurText assembling the headline, a soft indigo spotlight following the pointer across glass panels, CountUp instruments for the real portal numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo is the only interactive colour; pastels are atmosphere; status colours are darkened for ivory contrast.
Panels are frosted glass — white 65%, 16px blur, hairline border, layered soft shadow, 20px radius.
Fraunces display with an italic light accent line; Inter body; JetBrains Mono uppercase readouts.
The independent-demo ribbon sits above every page on a white/60 blur band.
Depth is soft and layered — never neon, never hard offsets.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only colour that invites a click.

rules.name: The Darkened Status Rule
rules.body: Status colours are darkened for 4.5:1 on ivory; never bright status hues on light ground.

rules.name: The Glass Rule
rules.body: Panels blur what is behind them; never opaque white cards, never dark glass on light ground.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: The headline's second line is Fraunces italic light in iris.

dos: Keep indigo as the only click-inviting colour.
Use Fraunces italic for editorial accent lines.
Carry the ribbon on every page.
Darken status colours for ivory contrast.
donts: Use dark panels or neon on this ground.
Use bright status hues on ivory.
Claim filing, acceptance, or government status anywhere.
Replace glass with opaque flat cards.
